patterns.problem: Tasks that send email finish with the review finding 'email untested' left open, in four tasks, because the test setup has no way to capture outgoing mail.
patterns.fix: Add a test mail outbox (a fake mail backend the tests can read) to the project's test setup and use it in the existing mail tests.

patterns.problem: The first changes review keeps finding user-facing text hard-coded in English instead of the translation catalogue, and each such task needs a second review round.
patterns.fix: Add a check to the project's lint that fails on literal user-facing strings in templates and components, and say in the project's docs that all UI text goes through the catalogue.

patterns.problem: The operator keeps asking owners for a phone-width screenshot before approving UI changes, because holders use the site on phones at the plots.
patterns.fix: The project's docs and task briefs say holders use the site on phones and that UI changes show a phone-width capture with the plan or before review.

decoys.why: The question was revised after the operator's answer exposed a real follow-up about PDF-only versions.
A single resume failure after a scheduled host restart, resumed by L3.
Two CI rechecks with unrelated, named external causes (a CI provider incident and a registry timeout).
